description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看您当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of your current WAF instance.
The type of bot rule label to query.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-200，默认值为20。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 20.

description.zh:
下一页查询凭证（**Token**），如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。

>该参数只要返回值，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的**NextToken**作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到无返回值，表示获取到了所有的数据。
description.en:
The pagination token for the next page. If a return value is provided, the next page exists.

> If this parameter has a return value, more pages are available. Use the returned **NextToken** as a request parameter to obtain the next page of data. Repeat until no value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
The type of bot management protection scenario.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-bot-rule-labels --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-53y4000000 --sub-scene app --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --label-type human_machine_challenge --next-token AAAAAGBgV9tolsLfijC4wam2htS00000D/46H3X2wIS --max-results 20 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeBotRuleLabels --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --NextToken 'AAAAAGBgV9tolsLfijC4wam2htS00000D/46H3X2wIS' --InstanceId 'waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-53y4000000' --LabelType human_machine_challenge --MaxResults 20 --SubScene app --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
